content.text: main is broken by ALI-734 (#1932): it added 'altitude' to the gateway's ESCALATION_UNTRUSTED_RUNGS but not to the UI mirror, and the parity test that exists to catch that drift now fails. Can you look into it?

Confirmed the key fact: `ESCALATION_UNTRUSTED_RUNGS` in the UI is referenced only at its declaration and in the parity test - `isTrustedForEscalation` consults the trusted set. So the one-line mirror fix is provably behaviour-neutral.

ALI-736 itself is complete and green. But main is broken by an unrelated merge, which blocks this PR and every other one.

questions.question: main is broken by ALI-734 (#1932): it added 'altitude' to the gateway's ESCALATION_UNTRUSTED_RUNGS but not to the UI mirror, and the parity test that exists to catch that drift now fails. #1932 was green on its own head because it predated #1933, which added the UI mirror; the combination was never CI'd until my PR. Push-to-main skips all test jobs, so main's green says nothing. How do you want the fix handled?

options.label: Fold the one-line fix into my PR
options.description: Add 'altitude' to ui/src/lib/decisions/scopeAltitudeMatrix.ts:33 in PR #1937, as a separate commit crediting ALI-734. Unblocks main immediately. I verified the set has no consumer (isTrustedForEscalation reads only the TRUSTED set), so it is behaviour-neutral, and the full UI suite passes with it (911 passed).

options.label: Put it on the ali-734 worktree as its own PR
options.description: Keep #1937 scoped to ALI-736. I open a separate one-line PR from the existing align-stack-ali-734 worktree. Cleaner attribution, but #1937 stays red until that merges, and so does every other open PR.

options.label: Just report it, I'll handle it
options.description: I leave #1937 as-is and stop. You fix main yourself.
